text:
Ravi (Sales): Heads up - CopperCom flagged an overcharge on their pilot invoice and asked for a one-time rebate + temporary extended terms. Need quick approval to avoid pause.
Elaine (Finance): Can you summarize the amount and root cause?
Ravi (Sales): Short: duplicate EU VAT captured due to region-routing tag bug on 2024-03-15. Invoice INV-2024-3321 shows duplicate tax of $18,500. They want refund $18.5k and Net60 on remaining pilot billing for 60 days only.
Sam (Acct Mgmt): Commercial ask captured: 1) Credit $18,500 2) Net60 for pilot period only 3) No pricing precedent beyond pilot.
Elaine (Finance): $18.5k under manual CFO threshold, finance ops can approve with EM sign-off. Need confirmation it's system/tax error not a negotiated discount.
Ravi (Sales): Confirmed — engineering found gateway mis-tag caused duplicate tax capture. Can share logs.
billing-bot: Gateway alert: duplicate tax capture TXN-88F2-03 linked to INV-2024-3321.
Elaine (Finance): Ok. We prefer to book as a tax adjustment credit, GL code needed and approval note for ticketing.
Sam (Acct Mgmt): Use GL 6205 - Sales Credits. I'll take ownership of client comms and ensure conversion milestones are tracked.
Nina (Legal): Need a one-paragraph amendment to the pilot MSA limiting Net60 to the pilot term and clarifying non-precedent. I'll draft and send to CopperCom counsel. Elaine, please confirm acceptance once drafted.
Elaine (Finance): I'll approve contingent on signed amendment language and an explicit memo that this is a tax correction, not a pricing concession. Approver name for the ticket: Elaine (Finance).
Ravi (Sales): I'll send draft logs and route the amendment for signature.
Sam (Acct Mgmt): For bookkeeping, invoice snippet: ```
Invoice: INV-2024-3321
Total charged: $24,200 (includes EU VAT)
Duplicate VAT portion: $18,500
Requested credit: $18,500
```
Nina (Legal): Draft sent to CopperCom legal (email ref copper-legal-2024-88). cc: sam@redwood, ravi@redwood.
Ravi (Sales): Signed amendment returned at 16:12. Uploaded signed PDF to deal folder: https://drive.redwood/drive/pilot-coppercom/amendment-signed.pdf
Elaine (Finance): Received signed amendment. Approving one-off credit $18,500 against INV-2024-3321 as "tax adjustment". Will apply Net60 for pilot only. Posting approval to TKT-4492 now and notifying accounting.
billing-bot: Refund initiated REF-2024-771 amount $18,500 applied to INV-2024-3321. Settlement pending.
Ravi (Sales): Great work, team. I'll monitor the pilot and follow up on conversion.
Elaine (Finance): Closing note for the record: entry with GL 6205, memo "one-off tax adjustment - CopperCom pilot", marked non-precedent.
Sam (Acct Mgmt): Noted. I'll add clause reference to renewal paperwork to prevent accidental reapplication.
Ravi (Sales): Closing thread. Thanks everyone :tada:
